text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri and Spanish counterpart Jaime Mayor Oreja sign accords to reinforce cooperation against drug trafficking and illegal immigration.
- Visiting Swiss foreign ministry delegation hails Morocco's advances in human rights.
- Morocco's health workers said they will hold a third strike from July 22 to 24.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says cocaine haul which washed up on Moroccan shores was initially bound for European markets.
- State-owned airline Royal Air Maroc says it will open up part of its capital to privatisation next year.
- Consultative Council in charge of following up social dialogue resumes activity. Despite social accord signed between unions and government in August last year, little progress was made.
